gate_policy.type_normalization: v2 accepts a vulnerability_type whose wording contains the sample audit_scope; the value is rewritten to the canonical scope only for the upstream scope comparison.
gate_policy.target_ports: v2 treats ports as a runtime concern: static screening blocks non-loopback hosts and credential-bearing URLs, not loopback ports.

limitations: AST screening is incomplete; dynamic URLs, redirects and indirect behavior require isolation and human review.
